# Public profile

3 routes. Base URL: `https://orbitwrite.com/api/v1`. Paths below are absolute.

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/v1/public-profile` | Read the workspace's public-page settings |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/public-profile` | Save the workspace's public-page settings |
| POST | `/api/v1/public-profile/channels/{accountId}/visibility` | Show or hide one channel on the public page |

### GET /api/v1/public-profile

Read the workspace's public-page settings

The page's custom links and channel order. Any member may read (`publicProfile:read`).

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — The page's settings
  - `PublicProfileSettings`
    - `links`: array of `PublicProfileLink`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `title`: string (max length 100), required
      - `url`: string (max length 2048), required
    - `channelOrder`: array of string, required — Channel ids in the order they appear on the page. Empty when the workspace hasn't set an explicit order.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### PATCH /api/v1/public-profile

Save the workspace's public-page settings

Requires `publicProfile:update`. A partial save — an omitted field is left unchanged, so reordering channels can't wipe the custom links.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `UpdatePublicProfileBody`
  - `organizationId`: string, required
  - `links`: array of `PublicProfileLink`
    - `id`: string, required
    - `title`: string (max length 100), required
    - `url`: string (max length 2048), required
  - `channelOrder`: array of string

**Responses**

- `200` — The saved settings
  - `PublicProfileSettings`
    - `links`: array of `PublicProfileLink`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `title`: string (max length 100), required
      - `url`: string (max length 2048), required
    - `channelOrder`: array of string, required — Channel ids in the order they appear on the page. Empty when the workspace hasn't set an explicit order.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/public-profile/channels/{accountId}/visibility

Show or hide one channel on the public page

Requires `publicProfile:update`. The flag is stored on the channel row, but showing a channel publicly is a public-profile decision, not a channel-management one.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accountId` | string | yes |  |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `SetChannelVisibilityBody`
  - `hidden`: boolean, required

**Responses**

- `200` — The mutation was applied
  - `PublicProfileMutationResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`
